openings.claim: Order trays may reduce selection/checking delay and omissions.
openings.discriminator: Selection/checking improves without comparable insertion change.
openings.probe: Compare trays with incumbent; include preparation and independent inventories.
openings.uncertainty: Switching and layout complexity remain confounded.

openings.claim: Ordered-layout diagrams may resolve short-partition confusion.
openings.discriminator: Correct placement improves while correctly positioned insertion retries persist.
openings.probe: Compare diagrams; observe placement, retries, help and ten-minute success.

openings.claim: Mapped unassembled kits combine completeness witnessing with placement guidance and remove workshop insertion.
openings.discriminator: Only insertion savings weaken reconciliation hypothesis; increased customer errors reject hybrid.
openings.probe: Compare linked assembled/unassembled samples; count replacement fit, stability, restraint and presentation checks in time.
openings.uncertainty: Check equivalence, label continuity, customer ability and acceptance unproved; assembly prohibition is optional.

openings.claim: Linked trays/diagrams may transfer component identity while retaining assembly.
openings.discriminator: Diagram adds placement benefit beyond trays; trays add checking benefit beyond diagrams.
openings.probe: Compare incumbent, trays, diagrams, linked assembled and mapped unassembled.
openings.uncertainty: Shared incorrect mapping can synchronize errors; identifiers may lose referents.

decision: Independently derive mappings from accepted orders first. Explore three samples per five arms, both workers, all counts and rare color; ten customers in five matched pairs compare linked assembled/unassembled. Time every stage. Preserve 30x20 footprint, assortment, removable partitions, ordered counts/colors; verify 500 initial, 0.40 recurring and fixed date. Synthetic small diagnostics cannot establish pilot thresholds: 59/60 complete, median <=8 minutes, >=90% unaided.
